dod_intent_evidence: Own-words About/Capabilities pages explicitly position the company as a federal SBIR/STTR R&D shop ('SBIR/STTR R&D: Focused feasibility work built around scoped prototypes, baselines, evaluation plans, and transition evidence') with a portfolio of disconnected Phase I/II awards spanning Air Force legal review (AILA), Air Force image forensics (Aletheia), Navy maintenance forms (AIM-FE), DoD scholarly-knowledge tooling (ASTERISK OSI), and DOE carbon-capture forecasting (EmiFor) — the business model is winning scoped SBIRs across unrelated domains, not fielding one capability.
what_they_do: A Pittsburgh-area federal AI R&D consultancy whose business is winning and delivering scoped SBIR/STTR prototypes across many unrelated federal domains (Air Force legal review, image forensics, Navy maintenance forms, DOE carbon capture) rather than fielding a single defense product.
